Default look (use this only if the Scene below does not specify different clothing/expression for this moment): Bare to the waist, or a dark grey (RGB 90,90,90) D-Class jumpsuit top pulled down to the waist, so the moving tattoo stays visible across his back and torso; matching dark grey jumpsuit trousers.
- scp-021: SCP-021, a large, elaborate oriental-style tattoo of a long serpentine dragon in black-grey ink (color RGB 40,40,45), covering roughly 0.8 square meters of a person's skin across the back and torso. Default look (use this only if the Scene below does not specify different clothing/expression for this moment): Coiled across the host's back and one shoulder, caught mid-slither.

Default look (use this only if the Scene below does not specify different clothing/expression for this moment): A plain white lab coat over a collared shirt and dark trousers, with a blank white ID card clipped to the chest pocket. In the doorway on the right, Attending Researcher (Male) stands making notes on a clipboard.
